metadata.title: Finiteness of Fuchsian equations with unitarizable monodromy on compact Riemann surfaces
metadata.abstract: We prove that, on any compact Riemann surface, there are only finitely many meromorphic projective connections with prescribed singular points and real exponent differences whose projective monodromy is unitarizable. We also establish properness and growth estimates for holonomy, including a relative version for smooth marked families, and derive finiteness results for spherical conical metrics and ramification divisors of stable extensions.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 证明紧致黎曼曲面上，固定奇点和实指数差且射影单值群可酉化的亚纯射影联络只有有限多个。建立 holonomy 的适当性与增长估计及光滑带标记族的相对版本，并导出球面锥度量与稳定扩张分歧除子的有限性。
analysis.breakthrough: 把单值群的酉化条件转化为射影联络和球面锥几何的有限性。
analysis.limitations: 奇点及实指数差须预先固定；单值群要求可酉化。
analysis.priorityReason: 黎曼曲面几何及球面锥度量的有限性范围明确
